tasks_completed.description: AC1/AC2 — handleSidebarDrop: synthesize deselected meal option back into editorTripData slots options[]
tasks_completed.changes: Inside handleSidebarDrop (line ~2338), when direction=board and srcSlotId is a meal slot: check if the option exists only in publishedDay.meals (PLAN-format, never in editorDay.slots[slotId].options[]). If so, push a synthesized option object into editorTripData.days[n].slots[srcSlotId].options[] before calling setEditorSelections null. Mirrors preserveCurrentAccommodationOption pattern.
tasks_completed.rationale: CandidatesSidebar mealsGroup is built exclusively from editorDay.slots[slotId].options[]. Items present only in publishedDay.meals were never synthesized and therefore never reappeared in sidebar after board→sidebar drag.

tasks_completed.description: AC3 R2 — bridge (window.setEditorSelection DnD path): true move semantics replacing R1 filter-only
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced R1 filter-only block in bridge (~line 2899) with true move semantics: capture srcOpt = srcSlot.options.find(o => o.option_id === optionId), ensure tgtSlot.options[] exists, push {...srcOpt} if absent, then filter from srcSlot. Codex Finding 1 fix: findSelectedOption needs the option in targetSlot.options[] to render board card correctly.
tasks_completed.rationale: R1 filter-only removed from origin but didn't add to target. On next re-render, findSelectedOption couldn't locate the option in targetSlot.options[], causing the board card to disappear.

tasks_completed.description: AC3 R2 — applyBridge (window.applyEditorSelection tap-to-select path): same true move semantics
tasks_completed.changes: Same true move semantics applied to applyBridge (~line 2924): capture srcOpt before filtering, push to targetSlotId.options[] if absent, then filter from originSlotId.options[].
tasks_completed.rationale: applyBridge is the tap-to-select path (AC14). Both selection paths must have identical move semantics.

tasks_completed.description: AC3 R1 — CandidatesSidebar mealsGroup.map(): hide cards whose option_id is currently selected
tasks_completed.changes: Added `if (isSelected) return null;` at top of mealsGroup.map() callback (~line 2499). Hides sidebar meal cards whose option_id is in editorSelections for any meal slot.
tasks_completed.rationale: Even after move semantics, a selected option can still appear in mealsGroup if it exists in a different meal slot's options[] (e.g. the dinner default option lives in dinner.options[] even when also selected as lunch). The isSelected guard definitively hides already-on-board cards.

tasks_completed.description: AC4 R1 — mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay: propagate editorDay.budget into rendered day
tasks_completed.changes: Added 3-line block: `if (editorDay && editorDay.budget) { day.budget = Object.assign({}, day.budget, editorDay.budget); }` after deep-clone in mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay (~line 2042).
tasks_completed.rationale: mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay deep-cloned publishedDay but never propagated editorDay.budget, so budget rows always showed static published values.

tasks_completed.description: AC4 R1 — recomputeBudget: map entry.breakdown categories onto editorTripData.days[n].budget; Finding 5 Number() type fix
tasks_completed.changes: After fetch('/api/budget/recompute') response, added setEditorTripData call mapping breakdown categories to budget fields. Changed `d.day === dayNum` to `Number(d.day) === Number(dayNum)` in resp.days.find (codex Finding 5).
tasks_completed.rationale: recomputeBudget discarded entry.breakdown, persisting only day_total. Strict === could miss day match if types differ (string vs number).

tasks_completed.description: AC6 — Meals candidate label: fixed to lang-conditional '餐厅' / 'Restaurant'
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced mealsLabel (slot name) with fixed `lang === 'local' ? '餐厅' : 'Restaurant'` in candidate card header span.
tasks_completed.rationale: mealsLabel rendered the origin slot name, misleading users.

tasks_completed.description: AC22 — Remove required/late-arrival/missing/skipped badges from all card types (5 blocks removed)
tasks_completed.changes: Removed 5 badge blocks: meals, cafe, attraction, entertainment, accommodation badge blocks.
tasks_completed.rationale: Badge UI was cluttering card view.

blast_radius.note: Template is consumed by html_generator.py to produce self-contained HTML bundles. Changes affect all generated trip HTML files. The beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846 trip HTML was regenerated and deployed.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — original design gaps, not regressions
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: R1: CandidatesSidebar built from editorDay.slots[].options[] only; PLAN-format items in publishedDay.meals never bridged. recomputeBudget discarded breakdown. applyBridge used highlight-not-move per M17b spec. R2: codex Finding 1 — R1 filter-only approach removed option from origin but didn't add to target, so findSelectedOption couldn't locate option on next render.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: R1: synthesize PLAN meals on board→sidebar drag; merge budget breakdown; fixed label. R2: true move semantics (copy to target then filter from origin) in both bridge and applyBridge; isSelected guard in sidebar; Number() type cast in recomputeBudget day lookup.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: R1+R2 combined: 8 distinct fixes across 5 separate functions. Badge removals ~35 deleted lines. R2 true-move blocks: 2x 10-line setEditorTripData blocks (bridge + applyBridge). Budget merge: 3-line block. No padding.
